goal: Persist Bora's current-role PURSUE/WATCH/REJECT decisions as a distinct Pursuit Truth axis using the existing Career OS JOBS and LOG Sheets V1 surfaces. Preserve append-only decision history, explicit supersession, deterministic idempotency, and stale-intent protection, while leaving system recommendation, Match Truth, exact identity, package semantics, Application Truth, Gold doctrine, and manual SUBMIT unchanged.
acceptance_conditions: Only PURSUE, WATCH, and REJECT are valid Bora decisions; system Job.decision/lane values are never reused as human authorization.

A decision can be persisted only when its Job_ID exactly matches an existing canonical JOBS row; unknown or noncanonical identifiers fail closed with no JOBS or LOG mutation. Discovery-platform IDs, screenshots, URLs, company/title text, or synthetic IDs can never be accepted as decision subjects.

Each successful human decision emits one deterministic append-only PURSUIT_DECISION LOG event and one bounded JOBS mutation of Bora_Decision only. The JOBS.Bora_Decision cell is a convenience/display projection of the latest successfully persisted human decision and may become stale; it is never an authorization surface.

The decision request must carry reviewed_context_fingerprint, and every successful decision event records Job_ID, decision, decided_at, decided_by=BORA, decision_run_id, optional reason_note, reviewed_context_fingerprint, decision_context_fingerprint, event_id, and supersedes_event_id. On success, decision_context_fingerprint MUST equal the supplied reviewed_context_fingerprint and the fingerprint recomputed from the current canonical JOBS row.

Each persisted decision LOG row uses Stage='PURSUIT_DECISION', Source='BORA', Status='NORMALIZED', Error_Code=null, Engine_Baseline='CAREER_OS_PURSUIT_DECISION_PERSISTENCE_V1', and canonical sorted-key compact JSON in Notes containing all decision-event fields. The decision parser consumes only rows with that exact Stage and Engine_Baseline. A regression passes existing production_ledger.state_from_ledger_rows() a LOG set containing PURSUIT_DECISION rows and proves existing ingestion/identity/gate rehydration state is unchanged.

event_id is exactly 'PDE_V1::' + SHA-256(lowercase hex) over canonical sorted-key UTF-8 JSON containing exactly Job_ID, decision, decision_context_fingerprint, supersedes_event_id, and caller-supplied decision_run_id. Wall-clock decided_at and reason_note are excluded. An exact replay is an identical event_id with an identical payload and supersedes_event_id and produces no duplicate LOG event or JOBS mutation; the same event_id with conflicting payload fails closed. A deterministic regression covers PURSUE -> REJECT -> PURSUE under unchanged context.
A new decision for a Job_ID must explicitly supersede the current latest event when one exists; wrong/missing supersedes_event_id fails closed rather than branching history.
Current decision is derived from the append-only event chain; history is never rewritten or deleted when Bora changes his mind.

Decision context fingerprint is computed deterministically from current explicit JOBS truth needed to prevent stale intent reuse, including Job_ID, Official_URL, Last_Verified, Pipeline_State, gate states, Role_Status, Match_State, and system Decision; missing fields remain explicit nulls rather than guessed values. Before persistence, the implementation recomputes this fingerprint from the current canonical JOBS row and requires exact equality with the caller-supplied reviewed_context_fingerprint. Any mismatch means the opportunity/analysis context changed after Bora's review and fails closed with no JOBS or LOG mutation.

The only authorizing pursuit surface is a pure deterministic derive_current_pursuit_state(current_jobs_row, append_only_decision_log_chain) result. If the latest decision event's decision_context_fingerprint no longer matches the fingerprint recomputed from the current JOBS row, the derived state is STALE_RECONFIRMATION_REQUIRED and cannot authorize downstream pursuit work, even if JOBS.Bora_Decision still visibly reads PURSUE.
PURSUE authorizes no submission and proves no qualification, immigration, actionability, package, or application fact; WATCH and REJECT likewise do not rewrite system analytical truth.

The existing JOBS.Bora_Decision column is display-only and never authorizes downstream work. It reflects the latest successfully persisted human decision and is intentionally not rewritten by unrelated later JOBS context changes. Authorization must always call derive_current_pursuit_state against the current JOBS row plus append-only PURSUIT_DECISION LOG events. A regression proves that after a JOBS context change, Bora_Decision may still read PURSUE while the derived state is STALE_RECONFIRMATION_REQUIRED and therefore non-authorizing.
No APPLICATIONS row and no docs/application/BORA_APPLICATION_HISTORY_V1.json entry is created or modified by this milestone.

The five-role dogfood regression fixture preserves seven human events with explicit reviewed_context_fingerprint values: Expansion PURSUE then REJECT, Jobright PURSUE then REJECT, and Dairyland/Mayo/Lids REJECT; current derived decision is REJECT for all five while both temporary PURSUE events remain historical.

The five-role fixture uses deterministic test JOBS rows with exact test Job_IDs and must not promote LinkedIn, Jobright, screenshot, title, URL, or other discovery-only identifiers into canonical Employer Truth.
A repeated replay of the complete five-role fixture is idempotent.
WATCH remains distinct from PURSUE and cannot authorize future Gold-package consumers.
No package generation, Drive persistence, application-history expansion, UI, scheduled Gmail, browser automation, or automatic submission is introduced.
No path outside allowed_paths changes and full canonical Assurance passes on the exact frozen candidate.
stop_conditions: Implementation requires fuzzy company/title matching, discovery URL identity, LinkedIn/Handshake/Jobright ID fallback, or any noncanonical subject key.

Implementation requires modifying existing exact-role identity, Match Truth, Candidate Truth, qualification/gate semantics, system recommendation semantics, Gold/package logic, Application Truth, or submission policy.
Implementation requires writing rejected/watch/pursue roles into BORA_APPLICATION_HISTORY_V1.json.
Implementation requires adding a database, a new Sheet tab, a UI, scheduled ingestion, browser automation, or auto-submit.
Implementation cannot make repeated identical decision events idempotent.
Implementation cannot detect and fail closed on stale human intent after material JOBS context changes.
Implementation permits a decision write without a caller-supplied reviewed_context_fingerprint that exactly matches the current canonical JOBS context fingerprint.
Any downstream authorization path can treat JOBS.Bora_Decision alone as current pursuit authorization without deriving state from the current JOBS row plus append-only PURSUIT_DECISION LOG history.
PURSUIT_DECISION LOG encoding is not deterministic, cannot be isolated by exact Stage/Engine_Baseline, or changes existing production-ledger rehydration semantics.
review_requirements: A frozen consequential implementation candidate requires full canonical Assurance, exact-byte fingerprinting, and independent adversarial review before promotion. Cursor is the normal reviewer when available. If Cursor is unavailable, stop before promotion unless Bora grants a fresh exact-task/exact-fingerprint alternate-review exception. No prior Claude authorization carries forward.
human_approval_requirements: Runtime implementation is NOT authorized by the existence of this contract alone. After this contract is independently reviewed and canonically recovered, Bora must explicitly authorize implementation of this exact bounded contract. After implementation and review, Bora must separately authorize release of the exact frozen candidate before commit/push/merge. Manual SUBMIT remains permanently Bora-controlled.
